philosophy: We do not provide 'customer support'; we provide 'Concierge Services'. Every interaction is an opportunity to reinforce the patron's entry into a world of sovereign luxury.

macros.subject: A Note Regarding Your Pawché Acquisition
macros.body:
Dear [Patron Name],

Thank you for reaching out to the Atelier. We understand the anticipation that comes with awaiting a new piece for [Dog's Name].

I have personally looked into your acquisition, and I am pleased to share that your order is [Status: being prepared / in transit]. At Pawché, we take immense care in the packaging and presentation of our items to ensure they arrive in pristine condition.

Your tracking details are as follows: [Tracking Link].

Should you require anything further as you prepare for the arrival of your pieces, please do not hesitate to contact us.

With high regards,

[Concierge Name]
Pawché Concierge

macros.subject: Ensuring a Perfect Fit for [Dog's Name]
macros.body:
Hello [Patron Name],

It is a pleasure to assist you in selecting the perfect silhouette for [Dog's Name]. In The Wardrobe, precision in fit is as essential as the quality of the fabric.

Based on the measurements provided, we would recommend the [Size]. Our couture pieces are designed with a [Structured/Relaxed] fit to allow for both elegance and comfort. 

If you find yourself between sizes, we generally suggest selecting the larger option to ensure [Dog's Name] moves with total ease and grace.

May we assist you with any other selections from the collection today?

Warmly,

[Concierge Name]
Pawché Concierge

macros.subject: Regarding Your Recent Return Request
macros.body:
Dear [Patron Name],

At Pawché, your satisfaction is our sovereign standard. We want every piece in your collection to be nothing short of exceptional.

We would be more than happy to facilitate a [Return/Exchange] for your [Product Name]. To begin this white-glove process, please [Link/Instructions]. 

Once the item returns to our Atelier and passes our quality inspection, we will immediately [Issue your credit / Dispatch your new selection].

Thank you for your continued patronage and for allowing us to make this right for you and [Dog's Name].

Best regards,

[Concierge Name]
Pawché Concierge

macros.subject: Welcome to the Inner Circle of Pawché
macros.body:
Hello [Patron Name],

It is a delight to see your interest in 'The Club'. This is more than a loyalty program; it is an exclusive community for those who view pet ownership as a curated lifestyle.

As a member of The Club, you will enjoy:
- Early access to new drops from The Wardrobe.
- Private invitations to acquire limited-edition pieces from The Vault.
- Complimentary white-glove shipping on all acquisitions over $75.

Your presence adds to the refinement of our community. We look forward to seeing [Dog's Name] featured in our next seasonal lookbook.

With high regards,

[Concierge Name]
Pawché Concierge

macros.subject: A Sincere Apology from the Atelier
macros.body:
Dear [Patron Name],

Please accept our most sincere apologies. The experience you described is not reflective of the Pawché standard, and we are committed to rectifying this with the utmost urgency.

I have already arranged for a replacement [Product Name] to be dispatched to you via priority service. In the meantime, please feel free to keep or donate the original item; there is no need for you to go through the trouble of returning it to us.

We value your trust above all else. Is there anything else I can do to restore your confidence in our Atelier?

Sincerely,

[Concierge Name]
Pawché Concierge
